first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public British National Grid physical building-footprint Polygon coordinates for the University of Exeter Forum, with explicit Forum/building-use identity bound to the same feature. The distinct ArcGIS item-data configuration endpoint for the University of Exeter Digital Estate Team Roof Access Safety Web App was used to dereference operational layer/service definitions rather than the prior item-metadata surface, but the no-login JSON payload was inaccessible through the web retrieval channel and direct network resolution failed before any configuration bytes were read. Therefore no Forum feature-service URL or physical-footprint geometry could be verified and no individual building record was accepted.
